tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott goal-loop Bland pathway, round 7. Work entirely inside your current working directory; never modify, create, or delete any file outside CWD. No network calls, no git, no MCP or Apps, do not load skills. Do not mint, attach, deploy, or call any API. CONTEXT - every claim below is backed by executed measurements, do not re-derive them: The round-6 draft (minted v102) fixed the silent-hop topology but live probes proved two remaining platform defects. DEFECT 1, edge label too narrow: the only scheduling edge out of the user-wait node n_goal_response is labeled 'wants a different day or time', which presupposes an existing offer; an opening statement like 'thursday please' matches no edge, the runtime stays parked, extraction never runs (proved: variables empty, BlandStatusCode stayed 200), and the node's offer-shaped prompt fabricates dates. When a user message DID literally match the label ('can we do a different day please'), extraction ran and the webhook fired - proving the pipeline works when the label matches. DEFECT 2, gateway body contract violated: the webhook body invented fields; the gateway replied HTTP 400 with error 'unknown field anchor for /availability' (reproduced offline in /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD6/gw-body-repro/gw-repro.txt, which also proves the accepted contract: the production v96 body with time_pref none returns 200 with 24 real slots, and time_pref latest returns 200 with true late-day slots). Additionally the round-6 extractors emit a literal sentinel string 'retain' (which reaches the gateway body) and fabricate values (extracted preference_from monday from a message containing no day). SOURCE MATERIALS (read-only; copy into CWD before editing): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD5/gl-direct-webhook-fix/ has the round-6 draft (pathway-goalloop-draft.json), its validator check_goalloop_graph.py (assertions 1-6), derive_goalloop.py, build_goalloop.py, and fixtures; /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD4/capture-v96/graph.json is the stored production graph - the single source of truth for extractor definitions and edge labels; /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD6/ holds the live probe envelopes and gw-repro.txt. THE FIX, exactly: (1) THREE availability webhooks replace the single n_goal_search, following the production convention of literal time_pref per node selected by semantic edges: n_goal_search with body time_pref 'none'; n_goal_search_latest with body time_pref 'latest'; n_goal_search_anchor with body time_pref 'anchor={{goal_anchor}}'. All three bodies are otherwise IDENTICAL to the stored production v96 n_search body fields: store, from, to, after, before, time_pref, slot_minutes, callID, user_text, user_verbatim - NO other field is permitted (no anchor, time_from, or time_to keys; that exact invention caused the 400). All three keep the round-6 n_goal_search url, method, headers, responseData, responsePathways (pathway targets updated only if node ids require it), and retry/skip settings. (2) EXTRACTORS: replace the extractVars on EVERY user-wait feeder node - n_goal_response, n_date_conflict, n_date_conflict_retry, n_gate_1, n_gate_2 - with the five production extractors from stored v96 n_ask, copied BYTE-EQUAL (user_verbatim, preference_from, day_part, time_after, preference_to). On n_goal_response ONLY, append one additional extractor goal_anchor (string): description must instruct extraction of a clock time like 09:30 am only when the patient names a specific target clock time, otherwise leave empty; it must not instruct any carry-forward or sentinel value. The word 'retain' must not appear in any extractor definition anywhere in the graph. Do not add goal_relation, time_from, or time_to extractors - intent selection now lives in edges, not variables. (3) EDGES from n_goal_response: retarget/relabel so all three searches are reachable: to n_goal_search with label exactly 'says any day, weekday, date, week, weekend, or time preference - including Saturday, this weekend, next week, or a month and day - or asks for the first available, soonest, earliest, or whenever opening - or asks for a different day than offered'; to n_goal_search_latest with label 'wants late, latest, last appointment, or end of day'; to n_goal_search_anchor with label 'asks for a time near, around, or close to a specific clock time'. Keep the existing gate, decline, and timeout edges unchanged. (4) All other former feeders of the search (n_date_conflict, n_date_conflict_retry, n_gate_1, n_gate_2, n_book_1, n_book_2) keep their round-6 direct edges but target n_goal_search (the none search), labels unchanged. (5) The prior round conventions all still hold: no n_goal_update, no silent Default feeding a webhook, executable conditions on responsePathways, no patient-facing waiting processor, verbatim slot-variable wiring in patient copy, derived-not-generated content. (6) VALIDATOR: extend check_goalloop_graph.py with ASSERTION 7 while keeping assertions 1-6 intact: (a) every Webhook whose url ends /availability has body fields strictly within the ten-field contract above and a time_pref value of none, latest, or anchor={{goal_anchor}}; (b) no extractor definition anywhere contains the string retain; (c) the n_goal_response edge to n_goal_search carries the day/weekday/weekend/time-preference enumeration and edges exist from n_goal_response to all three searches; (d) the five production extractor definitions on every user-wait feeder are byte-equal to a frozen copy of the v96 n_ask set embedded in the validator or loaded from a fixture file you ship in CWD. Failure output must be structured FAIL lines containing 'assertion 7' (or the specific older assertion number), never a traceback; success prints PASS. Your validator must PASS your new draft, must FAIL the untouched round-5 draft at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD3/gl-respond-wiring-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json, and must FAIL the untouched round-6 draft at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD5/gl-direct-webhook-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json, each with an assertion citation. (7) Update build_goalloop.py (and derive_goalloop.py if you keep it in the pipeline) so rerunning it deterministically regenerates pathway-goalloop-draft.json and the fixtures; update fixture-conformant.json to pass all seven assertions. (8) DEBUG.md documents round 7: both defects, the measured evidence (the 400 error text, the parked-node probe), what changed (must discuss the body contract and the edge labels), and the exact regeneration command. DELIVERABLES in CWD: build_goalloop.py, derive_goalloop.py if used, check_goalloop_graph.py, pathway-goalloop-draft.json, fixtures, DEBUG.md.
tasks.verified: The round-7 draft passes its seven-assertion validator, the same validator rejects both prior drafts with assertion citations, and an independent structural check proves gateway-contract bodies on three literal-time_pref searches, v96-verbatim extractors on every user-wait feeder, proven edge labels, and zero retain sentinels.
